patches.value: I=[0,1]={t∈ℝ:0≤t≤1}. When I or a subset of the real line is an argument of H or dim_H, it is identified with the subset of Eucl(1) obtained by t↦(t), the one-coordinate vector; this map has distance sqrt((t−u)^2)=|t−u|. Thus all diameter, cover and dimension notation for real subsets uses exactly their usual real-line metric. In λ(I) and real integrals I is the real interval itself.
